title: PNP sounds alarm over online posts of students carrying firearms

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police urged the public to use social media responsibly following separate incidents in Sultan Kudarat and South Cotabato involving students and alleged firearm-related online posts. “Let this be a reminder that social media is not a place to make threats or create fear,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.
